scene_prompt: Create a 3D soccer map in a modern floodlit stadium with a clear Roblox-avatar scale and style. A full soccer pitch sits at the center, bordered by sidelines and goal areas, with opposing goals at each end and spectator stands rising around the field for team-versus-team play.
blob:
### Genre
Sports is dominant: this is a player-versus-player soccer match in a stadium. No secondary genre is needed.

### Shape and preset
Use `field-bounded`, matching the Field Sport preset. It is a regulation-style soccer pitch centered inside a complete modern stadium; the prompt specifically supports the pitch, opposing goals, sidelines, and spectator setting, while the preset supplies the necessary playable field structure.

### Config requirements
Use `trigger-bounds` as both visible painted sidelines/end lines and an invisible foul boundary around the pitch. Use `startpoint-play` as the visible center circle and kickoff spot, with the corresponding invisible reset position. Use `trigger-scoring` as visible goal mouths at each end plus invisible scoring planes within them. Use `spectator-bleachers` as visible steep, tiered spectator stands rising around the field. These are the only invisible elements: the foul boundary, kickoff/reset position, and goal scoring planes; do not render them as markers.

### Layout components
The single main zone is a full rectangular green soccer pitch occupying the center and most of the map, with a halfway line, center circle, penalty boxes, goal areas, sidelines, and end lines clearly painted. Place one opposing goal centered on each short end of the pitch, facing inward. A thin perimeter apron separates the field boundary from continuous spectator stands on all four sides; the long-side stands are broad and the end stands frame each goal. The stands rise in simple stepped tiers, with floodlight structures positioned at the stadium corners or above the stand roofline to illuminate the entire pitch. Keep the ground flat, with trimmed turf and hard stadium circulation surfaces outside the field. Enclose the scene with the stadium bowl and outer stand walls. Compose it as a clean, centered, symmetrical arena viewed in an elevated isometric three-quarter angle, with both goals and the full field readable.

### Render order
Use `topdown`: valid opposing-team symmetry, field boundaries, and scoring geometry must remain legible and playable before the isometric stadium dressing is applied.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is large, driven by a full pitch plus spectator seating on every side. Theme: modern floodlit soccer stadium, crisp green turf, clean architectural seating, and chunky 3D Roblox-avatar proportions. Use `P0`; the tiered bleachers require elevation capture but no overhangs or additional map pass.
